findings.title: CC Session Outbox — ControlGroup mutation-kind classification + layout-shift
findings.sentence: A single reposition (the same node removed from its old spot and reinserted elsewhere) can arrive as separate remove/add records in either order -- browsers don't guarantee add-before-remove for what is logically one move -- so a remove-first ordering misclassified a real move as removed+created.
